claims.statement: JUnit Jupiter @Test marks individual test methods and @BeforeEach runs setup before each test method rather than starting a Spring application context.
claims.rationale: Official Jupiter annotation reference defines the lifecycle and execution timing.

claims.statement: JUnit Jupiter provides assertEquals, assertThrows and assertAll for checking observable values, expected exceptions and grouped behaviors.
claims.locator: JUnit Jupiter Assertions methods and examples
claims.rationale: JUnit 5 assertion reference defines equality and exception assertion methods.

claims.statement: Maven Surefire runs JUnit Jupiter tests through the JUnit Platform when an appropriate Jupiter TestEngine is available.
claims.locator: Using JUnit 5 Platform / Configuring JUnit Platform
claims.rationale: Official Surefire documentation identifies JUnit Jupiter engine discovery through Maven.

claims.statement: BigDecimal decimal arithmetic and setScale support exact decimal quantities without binary floating-point representations.
claims.rationale: Java 21 BigDecimal reference specifies decimal precision, scale and arithmetic contracts.

claims.statement: BigDecimal compareTo compares numeric values while equals requires equal scale and unscaled value representations.
claims.rationale: BigDecimal documentation explicitly contrasts numeric comparison and representation equality.

claims.statement: RoundingMode.HALF_UP rounds discarded half-way decimal values upward, while UNNECESSARY throws when reducing scale would lose value.
claims.rationale: Java 21 RoundingMode reference defines both fixed rounding behaviors.

claims.statement: A Maven test run using Surefire can execute JUnit tests without loading a Spring Boot ApplicationContext.
claims.locator: Using JUnit 5 Platform / Configuring JUnit Platform
claims.rationale: Surefire executes Jupiter engine test classes directly with no requirement for Spring libraries.
